<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <g aria-label="Status bar">
    <text x="20" y="21" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="334" y1="18" x2="334" y2="13" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="339" y1="18" x2="339" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="18" x2="344" y2="9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="349" y1="18" x2="349" y2="7" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="363" cy="13" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="366" y1="16" x2="370" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="376" y="8" width="13" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="389" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="378" y="10" width="9" height="8" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="Registration header">
    <polyline points="28,75 19,84 28,93" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <text x="195" y="91" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="20px" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Register</text>
    <line x1="20" y1="116" x2="370" y2="116" stroke="#F1F1F1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="Registration content">
    <text x="195" y="171" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="25px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Enter Your Mobile No</text>
    <text x="195" y="199" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Use your mobile number to continue</text>

    <text x="30" y="244" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Mobile number</text>
    <rect x="30" y="258" width="330" height="58" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="31" y="259" width="82" height="56" rx="9" fill="#F1F1F1"/>
    <text x="72" y="294" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="18px" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">+82</text>
    <polyline points="98,283 103,288 108,283" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="113" y1="270" x2="113" y2="304" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="130" y="294" font-family="Roboto" font-size="18px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">010 0000 0000</text>

    <text x="30" y="341" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">We’ll use this number to help secure your account.</text>

    <g aria-label="Submit button">
      <rect x="30" y="373" width="330" height="54" rx="10" fill="#5156D8"/>
      <text x="195" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">SUBMIT</text>
    </g>

    <g aria-label="Registration progress">
      <rect x="30" y="472" width="330" height="7" rx="4" fill="#F1F1F1"/>
      <rect x="30" y="472" width="110" height="7" rx="4" fill="#5156D8"/>
      <text x="30" y="511" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Account creation</text>
      <text x="360" y="511" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#5156D8">1 of 3</text>
    </g>

    <g aria-label="Account security note">
      <rect x="30" y="555" width="330" height="91" rx="15" fill="#F1F1F1"/>
      <circle cx="61" cy="590" r="15" fill="#5156D8"/>
      <rect x="56" y="588" width="10" height="11" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <polyline points="58,588 58,584 64,584 64,588" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="91" y="584" font-family="Roboto" font-size="18px" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Your information is secure</text>
      <text x="91" y="610" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Your mobile number will only be used</text>
      <text x="91" y="630" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">for account verification.</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <line x1="0" y1="746" x2="390" y2="746" stroke="#F1F1F1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g aria-label="Bottom navigation">
    <g>
      <polygon points="43,771 53,762 63,771 63,783 56,783 56,776 50,776 50,783 43,783" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="53" y="808" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="124" y="765" width="20" height="17" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5156D8" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="128" y1="777" x2="128" y2="771" stroke="#5156D8" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="134" y1="777" x2="134" y2="768" stroke="#5156D8" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="140" y1="777" x2="140" y2="773" stroke="#5156D8" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="134" y="808" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#5156D8">Invest</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="207" y="766" width="20" height="15" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polygon points="211,781 214,781 211,785" fill="#000000"/>
      <line x1="212" y1="771" x2="222" y2="771" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <line x1="212" y1="775" x2="219" y2="775" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <text x="217" y="808" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Activity</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="309" cy="770" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse cx="309" cy="780" rx="13" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="309" y="808" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
